_schema.purpose: Concurrent-session ownership ledger (Sprint 6, Phase 8). More than one Claude session can hold this checkout at once; this file is how they avoid editing the same subsystem. Before starting a work package, a session claims it here in its own commit. If a subsystem is already claimed and active, choose a different, non-overlapping wave.
_schema.rule: Claim before you build. Release on completion. Never edit files owned by an active claim you did not make.

fields.package: short slug for the work package
fields.owns: files/directories this package edits — the collision surface
fields.dependencies: packages or gates this waits on
fields.release_conditions: what must be true to enable it in production
